# Generated/consumed by scripts/native/gen_band3_link_stubs.py. Columns are tab-separated:
#     invariant: kind=data => class=data-blob ; kind=func => class in {assert-unreachable, ok-noop}

# Seeding rule (W0.2.S1, behavior-preserving MOVE): unknown => assert-unreachable (conservative).
# ok-noop is seeded ONLY where the source .s carried an explicit "safe to call, returns 0"
# justification for that symbol (currently: the Bink* video no-ops). Historical per-symbol
# "REMOVED — now strongly defined" prose for symbols that are no longer weak stubs lives in
# band3_link_stubs.s's git history, not here (this registry only tracks symbols that ARE
# NOTE: no runtime behavior depends on `class` yet (W0.2.S1 emits the single legacy shared
# no-op for every func row regardless of class). The loud per-symbol trampoline + census
# that make `class` load-bearing land in W0.2.S2/S3.
